d:
Singapore is an amazing country! It is so green, clean, extremely safe, with great food even at hawker centres, packed with so many things to do, hidden gems like the cultural neighbourhoods (my favourite) and to be honest, the vegan options were so good as well. It is one of my favourite places to visit off late. And if you need the ultimate guide for how to have the best time in Singapore, just watch this video. Here is some additional information:
Singapore is also called the city of fines, you could get in trouble for littering, jay-walking and even chewing gum! So be careful.
